'''Pad 223''' was a landing berth on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. It was there that the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] con-artist [[Marn Hierogryph]] was delivered the stolen provisioning [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Little Bivoli]]''.<ref name="K13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>
